statusLine.command: bash -c 'in=$(cat); d=$(jq -r ".workspace.project_dir // .cwd // empty" <<<"$in" 2>/dev/null); for r in "$d" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME"; do if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/.claude/statusline.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/.claude/statusline.sh" <<<"$in"; fi; done; echo "Claude Code"'
